svg.text: RBG3-MOTION, table rig: what to solder (top view)
Solder (green): U1 ESP32 socket, U4/U5 Z and Y driver sockets,
Skip (red X): U2 U3 + C1 C3 (drive wheels), J2, J4 J5, J10,
Small parts (resistors, 0805 caps, Q1, D1, D2): already fitted by JLCPCB.
JP1-JP4: nothing to solder (bridged on the board).
U1: female header in ONE right-hand row only (22.86 or 25.4 mm, match your DevKit).
Electrolytics: long leg to +. J13 = E-stop NO contact.
J14/J15: 2.54 mm pin headers (G + S), not JST.
